item.title: Your Party Conference: Total Chaos or the Future of Democracy?
item.description: It was predicted to be the final showdown: Zarah Sultana vs Jeremy Corbyn. But what emerged was a more nuanced drama: confusion, anger, but ultimately hope. Richard Hames and Jonah Braverman report from Your Party’s founding conference.

item.title: Zarah Sultana Wins Your Party Conference Showdown

item.description: David Lammy is expected to announce reforms that would see jury trials ended for sentences of three years or less. Plus: Rachel Reeves is under pressure over budget “lies”, and we discuss Zack Polanski’s economic influences. With Aaron Bastani and Kieran Andrieu.
